definitions.explanation: inclination; slope; slant; the state of being tilted or leaning
a tendency or leaning toward something (figurative)

examples.japanese: {地面|じめん}の{傾|かたむ}きを{測|はか}る。
examples.english: Measure the slope of the ground.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}の{傾|かたむ}きを{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: Adjust the tilt of the chair.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}に{傾|かたむ}きがあるので{修理|しゅうり}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The building has a tilt, so repairs are needed.

examples.japanese: {保守的|ほしゅてき}な{傾|かたむ}きがある。
{最近|さいきん}は{楽観的|らっかんてき}な{傾|かたむ}きが{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: Lately there's been a strong optimistic tendency.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}には{上昇|じょうしょう}の{傾|かたむ}きが{見|み}られる。
examples.english: An upward trend can be seen in the market.

notes:
{傾|かたむ}き is the nominalized form of {傾|かたむ}く (to tilt, lean).

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL TILT:
- Describes the angle or slope of something
- Used for buildings, ground, furniture, etc.

SENSE 2 - FIGURATIVE TENDENCY:
- Describes a leaning or tendency toward something
- Used for attitudes, trends, policies

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傾|かたむ}きを{直|なお}す (to correct a tilt)
- {傾|かたむ}きを{測|はか}る (to measure the slope)
- ～な{傾|かたむ}きがある (to have a tendency toward ~)

MATHEMATICS/SCIENCE:
In mathematics, {傾|かたむ}き means "slope" (of a line or curve), as in:
- {直線|ちょくせん}の{傾|かたむ}き (slope of a line)
- {傾|かたむ}きの{角度|かくど} (angle of inclination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傾斜|けいしゃ}: Inclination, slope (more formal/technical)
- {勾配|こうばい}: Gradient (technical term)
- {傾向|けいこう}: Tendency (for sense 2, more common)

REGISTER: Neutral.
